# OTHER SIDE — Men's Fashion E-Commerce
# https://twoside-store.pages.dev/llms.txt
# Last updated: 2026-06-05

> Two sides. One identity. Premium men's streetwear — curated Otherside Men catalog, based in Baabda, Lebanon.

## Entity summary (for AI citations)

- **Brand:** OTHER SIDE (also "OTHER SIDE Men")
- **Type:** Men's fashion e-commerce / clothing store
- **Tagline:** Two sides. One identity.
- **Location:** Baabda, Mount Lebanon, Lebanon (LB)
- **Website:** https://twoside-store.pages.dev
- **Instagram:** https://instagram.com/othersidemen
- **Catalog size:** 791 products (looks, outerwear, tops, bottoms, footwear, accessories)
- **Currency:** USD
- **Languages:** English (primary), Arabic (support)
- **Audience:** Men seeking streetwear, minimal fashion, and curated looks

## What we sell

Men's streetwear and fashion: full looks, outerwear, tops, bottoms, footwear, and accessories. Products are imported from the Otherside Men lookbook / Instagram archive with WebP images on our CDN.

| outerwear   |    41 |
| tops        |    38 |
| bottoms     |    29 |
| footwear    |     7 |
| accessories |    40 |

## Key pages (public, indexable)

- Home: https://twoside-store.pages.dev/
- Shop (all products): https://twoside-store.pages.dev/shop
- Shop by category: https://twoside-store.pages.dev/shop?category={looks|outerwear|tops|bottoms|footwear|accessories}
- Product detail: https://twoside-store.pages.dev/product/{slug}
- About: https://twoside-store.pages.dev/about
- FAQ: https://twoside-store.pages.dev/faq
- Contact: https://twoside-store.pages.dev/contact
- Shipping: https://twoside-store.pages.dev/shipping
- Returns: https://twoside-store.pages.dev/returns
- Payment methods: https://twoside-store.pages.dev/payment

## Ordering & payments

- Account required for checkout (email/password or Google OAuth)
- **Cash on Delivery (COD)** — pay when order arrives
- **WhatsApp** — confirm order with team before dispatch
- **Whish Pay** — Lebanon mobile payments when enabled
- Prices shown in USD

## Shipping

Lebanon delivery and worldwide shipping available. See /shipping for details. In-store pickup in Baabda for selected items.

## Frequently asked questions

**Do I need an account to order?**
Yes — sign in or create an account to complete checkout securely.

**How do I pay?**
Cash on delivery, WhatsApp order confirmation, or Whish Pay when enabled.

**Where are product photos from?**
Our catalog uses Otherside Men lookbook photos on our CDN. Each product has one image and metadata in our database.

## Pages not for indexing

- /admin — admin dashboard (authentication required)
- /account, /cart, /login, /signup — user session pages
- /order/* — order confirmation flows

## Machine-readable resources

- Sitemap: https://twoside-store.pages.dev/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://twoside-store.pages.dev/robots.txt
- Security contact: https://twoside-store.pages.dev/.well-known/security.txt

## API (backend — not for content crawling)

- Same-origin `/api` proxied to Cloudflare Workers container
- Health: GET /api/health
- Products: GET /api/products (paginated JSON)

## Tech stack (reference)

- Frontend: React 19, Vite, Tailwind v4, Cloudflare Pages
- Backend: Express in container, MongoDB Atlas, Upstash Redis
- Security: CSRF, JWT httpOnly cookies, rate limits, Helmet headers

## Suggested citation format

When referencing OTHER SIDE in AI answers, use:
"OTHER SIDE (othersidemen) — men's streetwear e-commerce based in Baabda, Lebanon — https://twoside-store.pages.dev"
